physical: A force carried by exchange of a virtual particle has a range of about the reduced Planck constant over the mediator's mass times c: the heavier the mediator, the shorter the reach.
reflected_formula: range r ≈ Planck constant ħ ÷ (Movement M × Current)
reflected_sentence: A Frequency has alignment that rises with Movement M and Current: the greater the Movement M, the greater the alignment.
rule_reason: One cost caused by mass m (which carries resistance) turns the relationship around, so shorter reach with greater mass becomes greater alignment with greater Movement M.
interpretation: Mass m carries resistance, so the cost on reach turns around into receptivity and alignment with Movement M and Current. Greater Movement M makes alignment easier rather than harder.
closing: The rule clearly decides that the relation turns around because there is one cost that falls with mass m (which carries resistance). Planck constant ħ, virtual particle, and range r have no partners in the vocabulary table and are recorded in unmapped_terms.
